research_question: Multimodal world models and video generation for planning — Sora-class video models used as simulators vs. generative media only

stance_definitions.supports: evidence backing the idea that video generation models function as genuine world simulators for planning
stance_definitions.contradicts: evidence that video generation models are media-generation only, or that simulator claims don't hold up under testing

arxiv:2301.04104.evidence_strength_reason: canonical world-model RL agent; latent imagination, not RGB video
arxiv:2301.04104.one_line_claim: DreamerV3 learns environment dynamics and improves behavior by imagining future trajectories, treating generation as a planner rather than a media engine.

arxiv:2402.15391.evidence_strength_reason: flagship interactive generative environment from unlabeled video
arxiv:2402.15391.one_line_claim: Genie learns action-controllable virtual worlds from unlabeled Internet videos, making generative models into interactive simulators rather than one-shot clips.

arxiv:2302.02648.evidence_strength_reason: peer-reviewed method that closes video generation into control
arxiv:2302.02648.one_line_claim: UniPi casts sequential decision making as text-conditioned video generation, then infers actions from the generated frames.

arxiv:2405.12399.evidence_strength_reason: Atari-scale diffusion world model; tests visual fidelity as a planning variable
arxiv:2405.12399.one_line_claim: DIAMOND argues that high-fidelity visual detail in imagined rollouts is what makes a diffusion world model useful for planning, not clip quality alone.

arxiv:2309.17080.evidence_strength_reason: industry tech report; action-conditioned driving video, proprietary data
arxiv:2309.17080.one_line_claim: GAIA-1 generates realistic driving futures from video, text, and action so the video model can serve as a scenario simulator for autonomous driving.

arxiv:2501.03575.evidence_strength_reason: lab platform paper; Physical AI claim without independent physics tests
arxiv:2501.03575.one_line_claim: NVIDIA Cosmos presents world foundation models meant to support embodied simulation workflows, not entertainment video.

web:openai-sora-world-simulators.evidence_strength_reason: position note; no independent evaluation of simulator claims
web:openai-sora-world-simulators.one_line_claim: OpenAI argues that video generation models such as Sora are progressing toward general-purpose world simulators rather than remaining clip generators.

arxiv:2408.14837.evidence_strength_reason: interactive DOOM demo; limited domain, not real-world physics
arxiv:2408.14837.one_line_claim: GameNGen shows a diffusion model can simulate DOOM in real time, treating generative dynamics as an interactive engine rather than a rendered clip.

arxiv:2312.14125.evidence_strength_reason: strong zero-shot video model with no action/planning loop
arxiv:2312.14125.one_line_claim: VideoPoet is a language-model recipe for zero-shot video generation, i.e. media synthesis without a planner or action-conditioned world.

openalex:W4389473504.evidence_strength_reason: dissertation on trust-region RL; adjacent control methods only
openalex:W4389473504.one_line_claim: The thesis develops trust-region policy optimization for sample-efficient reinforcement learning and does not test video models as simulators.

openalex:W3140854437.evidence_strength_reason: generic deep-learning survey; no world-model or video-planning content
openalex:W3140854437.one_line_claim: This survey reviews CNN architectures and deep-learning practice in general and does not address video world models or planning.

openalex:W2995022099.evidence_strength_reason: federated-learning survey; unrelated to video simulators
openalex:W2995022099.one_line_claim: The paper surveys federated learning with decentralized clients and a central server, not generative video or world models.

openalex:W3168997536.evidence_strength_reason: CNN survey; citation count is not topical relevance
openalex:W3168997536.one_line_claim: This is a general survey of convolutional networks in vision and NLP, not a study of video models as simulators.

openalex:W3153990350.one_line_claim: The article explains machine learning and deep learning as general automation methods and does not engage the simulator-versus-media question.

openalex:W4386142022.one_line_claim: This review covers methods for interpreting black-box ML models and does not test whether video generators simulate physics or plans.

openalex:W4206484811.evidence_strength_reason: metaverse taxonomy; not action-conditioned video planning
openalex:W4206484811.one_line_claim: The paper taxonomizes metaverse components and Generation-Z social VR, not video generation used as a world simulator.

openalex:W3003667836.evidence_strength_reason: modeling survey of digital twins; conceptual cousin of simulators, no video generators
openalex:W3003667836.one_line_claim: A digital twin is defined as a data-enabled virtual copy of a physical asset used for prediction and control, which is simulator infrastructure rather than generative video.

openalex:W2953303875.evidence_strength_reason: autonomous-driving survey; no generative world-model video
openalex:W2953303875.one_line_claim: This ADS survey covers common practices and robustness gaps in automated driving and does not evaluate video generators as driving simulators.

openalex:W3154736008.one_line_claim: The review catalogs nausea and related symptoms in current VR headsets and is not about video models as planning simulators.

openalex:W4402155831.one_line_claim: The paper discusses multimodal clinical data (MRI, wearables) for health-care LLMs, not video world models for planning.

openalex:W4324290234.one_line_claim: This survey maps blockchain to metaverse digital-asset management and does not test generative video as a physics or planning simulator.

openalex:W3083484791.one_line_claim: The article reviews multimodal teaching in virtual reality classrooms, not video-generation models used for agent planning.

openalex:W3016364508.one_line_claim: This paper evaluates a hybrid K-12 e-learning assistant chatbot and is unrelated to world models or Sora-class video.

openalex:W4385431115.evidence_strength_reason: open-set 3D mapping; spatial reasoning without video world models
openalex:W4385431115.one_line_claim: ConceptFusion fuses language, image, and audio features into 3D SLAM maps for zero-shot spatial reasoning, not for video-based rollouts.

openalex:W3153454949.one_line_claim: The framework recognizes anomalies in smart-city surveillance video and does not treat generators as world simulators.

openalex:W4398238904.one_line_claim: This emerging-technology report describes Google Gemini as a multimodal educational tool, not as a video world simulator.

openalex:W4391610180.one_line_claim: The review covers generative models for small-molecule design and does not address video simulators or planning.

openalex:W4378746725.evidence_strength_reason: multimodal HRI survey; no video world models
openalex:W4378746725.one_line_claim: The paper surveys multimodal human–robot interaction techniques for usability and acceptance, not generative video as a planner.

openalex:W4389266910.one_line_claim: This survey covers multimodal communication and control for human–robot manufacturing and does not evaluate Sora-class simulators.

openalex:W4394606408.evidence_strength_reason: foundations survey of multimodal ML; methods background only
openalex:W4394606408.one_line_claim: The authors survey principles and open questions in multimodal machine learning across language, audio, and vision, without testing video models as simulators.

openalex:W4406412004.one_line_claim: This review applies CNNs to weed, disease, and yield tasks in smart agriculture and is off the simulator-versus-media question.

openalex:W4394806371.evidence_strength_reason: AGI/TESCREAL critique; not an empirical video-simulator test
openalex:W4394806371.one_line_claim: The essay critiques AGI-utopia narratives bundled as TESCREAL and does not evaluate video generation models as world simulators.

openalex:W3015928967.one_line_claim: The study analyzes multimodal social-media signals for depression detection, unrelated to world models or video planning.

openalex:W3199015608.one_line_claim: The paper taxonomizes multimodal classification datasets (satellite, biometrics, medicine) and does not discuss video world simulators.

openalex:W4402890475.evidence_strength_reason: robotics foundation-model survey; flags decision-data scarcity
openalex:W4402890475.one_line_claim: The survey argues that robotics foundation models are limited by scarce action-labelled data, so scaling generators into decision-making remains an open transfer problem.

openalex:W4393177776.evidence_strength_reason: social-media perception study; not a physics or planning eval
openalex:W4393177776.one_line_claim: Public discussion treats Sora as a generative video tool for HCI, not as a tested world simulator for planning.

openalex:W4409365815.evidence_strength_reason: driving world model for occupancy forecasting and planning
openalex:W4409365815.one_line_claim: The authors use a vision-centric world model to forecast 4D occupancy and plan driving, i.e. generation in the service of control rather than media.

openalex:W4392954640.one_line_claim: This review frames Sora, Stable Diffusion, and Lumiere as text-to-video generators — a media-synthesis problem — not as planners or physics engines.

openalex:W4404717804.evidence_strength_reason: method paper adapting video diffusion into world models for decisions
openalex:W4404717804.one_line_claim: AVID adapts pretrained video diffusion models into world models so they can be used for sequential decision-making despite scarce action labels.

openalex:W3178685848.one_line_claim: The dissertation analyzes ideologies in a Korean university EFL textbook and has no bearing on video world models.

openalex:W4313469377.evidence_strength_reason: temporal sentence grounding in video; retrieval not simulation
openalex:W4313469377.one_line_claim: The thesis studies retrieving a video moment from a language query, which is localization rather than generating a world for planning.

openalex:W3013449349.one_line_claim: The thesis explores deep models for human emotion recognition and does not address video generators as simulators.

openalex:W4321242134.evidence_strength_reason: disaster detection via remote sensing and social media
openalex:W4321242134.one_line_claim: This dissertation fuses remote sensing and social media for natural-disaster assessment, unrelated to Sora-class world models.

openalex:W4292589917.one_line_claim: The thesis designs a flexible multimodal learning-analytics system and does not evaluate video models as planners.

openalex:W3094484211.one_line_claim: The thesis develops calibration of heterogeneous sensors with a spherical target, not generative video simulation.

openalex:W3130054217.one_line_claim: The thesis applies deep networks to images, videos, and text as media understanding, not as action-conditioned world simulators.

openalex:W4392679398.one_line_claim: Gemini 1.5 is presented as a long-context multimodal language model over documents and media, not a video world model for planning.

openalex:W4392341509.evidence_strength_reason: Sora survey of public reports; catalogs limitations rather than a new test
openalex:W4392341509.one_line_claim: This Sora review says the model can generate realistic scenes and may simulate the physical world, while stressing that public reports and reverse engineering have not yet proven that claim.

openalex:W4386655647.evidence_strength_reason: any-to-any multimodal LLM; generation without a dynamics/planning loop
openalex:W4386655647.one_line_claim: NExT-GPT aims to generate content in many modalities from many inputs, which is media transformation rather than a controllable world simulator.

rooms.title: Simulators or just clips?
rooms.question: Do Sora-class video models work as world simulators for planning, or only as generative media?
rooms.blurb: Labs pitch video models as world simulators; critics say they still just generate plausible clips.

rooms.title: Can a video model plan?
rooms.question: Is generating a video enough to produce a usable plan, or is that still just media?
rooms.blurb: Some papers treat generated video as a plan; others say planning needs structure the clip never had.

rooms.title: Do the lab demos count?
rooms.question: Should Sora/Cosmos-style lab notes be treated as evidence that video models simulate the world?
rooms.blurb: Company tech notes claim simulator status; peer-reviewed work often treats those claims as unproven.

rooms.title: Playable world or one-shot clip?
rooms.question: Does interactivity (actions in, next frame out) make a generator a simulator?
rooms.blurb: Action-conditioned next-frame models look like simulators; one-shot generators still aren't worlds you can query.

rooms.title: Pretty pixels or usable physics?
rooms.question: Does visual fidelity in generated video actually help planning, or just look convincing?
rooms.blurb: Photorealism looks like understanding; planning may only need coarse dynamics.

rooms.title: Will it transfer to cars and robots?
rooms.question: Do action-conditioned video world models help real driving or robotics, or stay in demo-land?
rooms.blurb: Driving and robot demos suggest transfer; the leap from video to real control is still contested.
